svg.title: VDJdb paratope motif atlas
svg.desc: Five epitope groups, three existing TCREmp motifs per epitope, and seven sequences per motif, coloured using stored nucleotide boundaries. Teal diamonds mark epitopes; teal rings mark paratope motifs.
svg.text: VDJdb · a map of receptor recognition
105 displayed sequences · 15 TCREmp paratope motifs · 5 epitopes
Anchor-inclusive CDR3s; inferred V/D/J boundaries. Mixed codons use split colours. Branches show membership, not distance.
